The fully cleared rational polynomial identity proves equality of Laplace transforms near zero; uniqueness and continuity justify the generic-ray limit.
Inherited product-join rules and the analytic tail hypotheses give a strictly increasing root sequence and an infinite-limit enclosure.
Taking the larger witness from the new padded family and the original finite-separation family preserves separation in every dimension at least nine and has the new limit.
